entries.evidenceSource: Direct live application via `supabase db query --linked --file supabase/migrations/67_resident_get_current_assignment.sql` against project gdumksfffewpdqqwvcdo, executed by the human per explicit per-step authorization, only after migration 66 was confirmed healthy.
